title: Remote Access
subtitle: Tailscale private network: this server and the devices reachable for maintenance.
privateOnly: Maintenance only uses the Tailscale private network; nothing goes over the public IP. Cloudflare remains responsible only for published services.

degraded.title: Partial read
degraded.description: Some telemetry could not be refreshed. Available data is still shown; refresh before running an action.

unavailable.title: Remote Access unavailable
unavailable.description: Could not query this server's Tailscale. Check the host bridge and try again.

devices.search: Search by name, IP, OS or group
devices.name: Device

confirmRestart.title: Restart Tailscale on this server
confirmRestart.description: Restart the Tailscale service on {{hostname}}? Connectivity to every device may drop for a few seconds.

workstations.title: Workstations
workstations.search: Search by name, IP, location or client
workstations.tailnetUnavailable: The tailnet could not be read right now; readiness uses the SSH probe only, and anything unread shows as Unknown.
workstations.empty: No workstations yet. Use "Sync from tailnet" to bring in the private network's computers.
workstations.deleteGroupDescription: Group {{name}} will be deleted. Its workstations stay registered; they just leave the group.

sync.failed: Could not read the tailnet to sync.

import.help: Tailnet devices not in the inventory yet. Tick the ones that are client workstations; the rest stay in the tailnet only and never come back by themselves.

failure.connection: Could not connect — the command did not run
failure.command: The command exited with an error

run.title: Run a command
run.mixedOs: The selection mixes Windows with Linux/macOS: machines that don't fit the chosen type show as "Not run".
run.maskingNote: Passwords, tokens and keys in the command and output are masked before being stored.
run.reviewSummary_one: Will run on {{count}} machine, as {{shell}}, with a {{timeout}} s limit:
run.reviewSummary_other: Will run on {{count}} machines, as {{shell}}, with a {{timeout}} s limit:
run.reviewNote: Machines that are disabled, have no login, run an incompatible OS or are busy with another command are skipped and show the reason.

execution.title: Execution
execution.subtitle: By {{who}} on {{when}} · {{targets}}
execution.cancelDescription: {{count}} machine(s) that haven't started won't run. Those already running finish normally.

prepare.title: Prepare {{name}}
prepare.step2Windows: Open PowerShell as administrator, paste the script below and press Enter.
prepare.step2Posix: Open Terminal, save the script as preparar.sh and run: sudo sh preparar.sh
prepare.step3: Come back and click "Check now": the station should become Ready.
prepare.keyCreated: A new key was generated for this station and stored (encrypted copy).
prepare.safeNote: The script can be run more than once. It only turns SSH on (accepting the tailnet only) and adds ForgeHub's key; it never removes accounts or other keys.

policy.title: Tailnet policy (ACL)
policy.subtitle: Copy of the Tailscale console policy, checked for the rule maintenance depends on: ForgeHub's server being able to open SSH to the client tags.
policy.pasteHelp: Paste the whole policy from the Tailscale console (Access controls › Edit file). Recording it here doesn't change Tailscale: changes are applied there.
policy.empty: No policy recorded yet. Record the current copy so ForgeHub can check whether it can reach the stations.
policy.allGood: The server ({{server}}) can open SSH to every client tag.
policy.missing_one: The server ({{server}}) can't open SSH to {{count}} client tag. Its stations will read "Offline" or "Not prepared" even with SSH on. Add the rule below in Tailscale and record the new version here:
